selection_basis: Recorded adult workplace/peer/comparable role contexts; text-based candidates only, not visual validation or status labels.
must_check: Whether roles are readable without text/audio

recorded_candidates.character_setup: Two software engineers on the same development team.
recorded_candidates.scenario: Achieving their working together results in a coding challenge victory.

recorded_candidates.character_setup: Two co-workers who have been collaborating closely on a work project. One is a meticulous and hardworking individual, and the other is an inspired visionary.
recorded_candidates.scenario: The visionary co-worker reveals how she came up with the brilliant idea that made their project successful, leaving the meticulous co-worker impressed and full of adoration.

recorded_candidates.character_setup: An enthusiastic newbie in his early twenties eager to impress and a long-time employee in her mid-thirties, comfortable in her role.
recorded_candidates.scenario: Discovering they have successfully secured a high profile project the team has been pitching for.

recorded_candidates.character_setup: A newly hired junior employee who is quite naive and an experienced senior who is very wise.
recorded_candidates.scenario: The junior employee successfully gives a presentation at a team meeting, impressing the senior who then takes the junior under their wing for further mentorship.

recorded_candidates.character_setup: Two co-workers, one with a passion for nature photography, and the other, with a keen interest in plants and wildlife.
recorded_candidates.scenario: They're in the office, chatting over a cup of coffee as the nature-lover excitedly shares his recent weekend getaway photos of beautifully taken shots of wildlife and picturesque sceneries.

recorded_candidates.character_setup: Two co-workers, one a meticulous introvert (character A), the other a spontaneous extrovert (character B).
recorded_candidates.scenario: Character B attempts to teach character A an impromptu dance routine in the break room during their lunch break.

recorded_candidates.character_setup: Two colleagues, one an experienced senior executive and the other a young and ambitious trainee.
recorded_candidates.scenario: They are discussing about a project they've been working on for months which they just found out has been a huge success.

recorded_candidates.character_setup: Two co-workers, a project manager in her 30s and a software engineer in his 40s who have known each other for several years.
recorded_candidates.scenario: During a late-night working session at the empty office, they confess their feelings for each other.

recorded_candidates.character_setup: Two coworkers, one a veteran in the company, jaded but full of knowledge, and the other a fresh newcomer interested in learning as much as possible.
recorded_candidates.scenario: The newcomer approaches the veteran to ask about their experiences and advice after discovering the importance of a project they had worked on in the company's past.

recorded_candidates.character_setup: One long-tenured employee at an advertising firm and one new recruit right out of college.
recorded_candidates.scenario: Long-tenured employee shows the new recruit an awe-inspiring presentation that clinches a huge deal for their firm.

recorded_candidates.character_setup: Two co-workers, a software engineer and a project manager, working in a tech start-up.
recorded_candidates.scenario: They are calmly discussing and planning for the next project deadline over some coffee, in an empty office, late in the evening.

recorded_candidates.character_setup: Two co-workers, one older and experienced, another young and new to the job.
recorded_candidates.scenario: The older worker is showing the young one their job's intricacies, the young one is completely enthralled by the complexity and knowledge of their older colleague.

recorded_candidates.character_setup: Two office workers, one newly-promoted, the other a veteran at the company.
recorded_candidates.scenario: They have been working overnight to complete a vital project, and they just received news that their management has accepted their work.

recorded_candidates.character_setup: Two co-workers in a small office, one is a diligent office worker and the other is his laid-back friend.
recorded_candidates.scenario: The laid-back co-worker, thought to be disinterested in promotions, announces that he has been offered the position of manager.

recorded_candidates.character_setup: Two co-workers, around the same age, who have been working in the same small company for over 10 years.
recorded_candidates.scenario: they are in their old office building on their last day before moving to a new location, reminiscing about their journey together and their shared experiences.

recorded_candidates.character_setup: A junior employee who is on a strict diet and a senior colleague who is known for his delicious homemade pastries.
recorded_candidates.scenario: They are together in the breakroom, the colleague has just opened a box of his freshly made pastries.

recorded_candidates.character_setup: Two co-workers, one new and moderately reserved, the other more experienced and somewhat oblivious.
recorded_candidates.scenario: During lunch break in the office pantry, they realize they've accidentally brought each other's lunch.

recorded_candidates.character_setup: Two co-workers, who are both data entry clerks at a small accounting firm.
recorded_candidates.scenario: They are sitting in their cubicles on a slow Friday afternoon, passing time by sharing workplace stories and watching the clock tick slowly.

recorded_candidates.character_setup: Two colleagues, a data analyst and an IT specialist, who have been working together for a year in the same IT firm.
recorded_candidates.scenario: They receive a cryptic email from their boss about an upcoming project, and they try to figure out what the project might be about.

recorded_candidates.character_setup: A new intern in a high-pressure tech firm and an experienced, but sympathetic colleague.
recorded_candidates.scenario: During a stressful period of tight project deadlines, the intern confesses to the colleague that they're afraid they aren't good enough to handle the job.

recorded_candidates.character_setup: Two co-workers, both mid-30s, who've been working together closely for some time.
recorded_candidates.scenario: While staying late in the office one night, they share a deeply painful past memory, finding support in each other in the process.

recorded_candidates.character_setup: Two co-workers: One who has been with the company for years and another who is a new hire.
recorded_candidates.scenario: The veteran employee discovers that the new hire has unintentionally made a critical error that could cost the company, leading to a heated confrontation.

recorded_candidates.character_setup: Two co-workers, working late at a spooky, desolate office.
recorded_candidates.scenario: After the lights suddenly go off, they start hearing strange noises and decide to investigate.

recorded_candidates.character_setup: Two long-time co-workers of the same age who work in the same office: an upbeat office manager and a quiet bookkeeper.
recorded_candidates.scenario: The office manager has found out that their company is going to be shut down and must convey this sad news to the bookkeeper.

recorded_candidates.character_setup: Two coworkers, one a fresh hire straight out of college, the other a tenured employee at the company.
recorded_candidates.scenario: The older coworker is eating a disgustingly smelly lunch at his desk, and the unfazed reactions of those around him shocks and disgusts the new hire.

recorded_candidates.character_setup: Two night-shift security guards at a large, quiet, and spooky museum.
recorded_candidates.scenario: They are working in the middle of the night, when strange, unnerving, and fear-inducing phenomena begin to occur, such as lights flickering, strange noises, and objects moving on their own.

recorded_candidates.character_setup: Two work colleagues who commute together on the train every day, one is a shy accountant and the other is a bright graphic designer.
recorded_candidates.scenario: On the morning train, they find themselves alone in the compartment and the shy one musters up the courage to express their feelings.

recorded_candidates.character_setup: Two middle-aged office workers, who share a daily commute on the train to work.
recorded_candidates.scenario: Both experiencing a painful break-up, they share their stories, reflecting on the pain and starting to find some comfort in mutual understanding and companionship.

recorded_candidates.character_setup: Two trustworthy business partners, who have been working together for several across different ventures.
recorded_candidates.scenario: One morning during their regular virtual meeting, they suddenly discover that their little-known start-up has become an overnight sensation, attracting millions of users and generating significant media buzz.

recorded_candidates.character_setup: Two business partners, one being risk-averse and the other one being risk-taking.
recorded_candidates.scenario: They are staying late in their office, discussing the consequences of a big deal that could either make their company prosper or bankrupt.

recorded_candidates.character_setup: A veteran company manager and a newly recruited employee whose first job this is.
recorded_candidates.scenario: At the coffee station, discussing the ethos and calm pace of the office.

recorded_candidates.character_setup: A compassionate boss who values the well-being of their employees, and a subordinate who's going through a difficult time.
recorded_candidates.scenario: Late in the evening at the office, the subordinate receives a sad personal phone call, and the boss provides a listening ear and comforting words.
